literal_meaning: তাঁবু বা বিছানার তল্পি গুটিয়ে ফেলা (folding up a tent or bedding)
example_sentences_in_bangla: ব্যবসায় লোকসান হওয়ায় সে তল্পি গুটিয়ে চলে গেল।
এই দোকানে আর লাভ নেই, তল্পি গুটানোর সময় এসেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: Due to losses in business, he folded his tent and left.
There's no profit in this shop anymore; it's time to pull up stakes.
history: This idiom originates from the practice of nomadic traders or gypsy-like communities in Bengal who would pack up their tents (তল্পি) and move on when business dried up, reflecting a historical lifestyle of itinerant commerce.
note: The idiom evokes the image of transient livelihoods in rural or semi-urban Bengal.
